text:
Happy World Teachers' Day! 

Today, I want to recognize the educators who have dedicated their careers to opening doors for our children and supporting the next generation of leaders. 

For years, I fought to reform the Windfall Elimination Provision (WEP), an unfair provision that devastated Social Security benefits for almost 90,000 retired public servants—teachers included—here in Massachusetts. 

Teachers and public servants should never be penalized for playing by the rules. That is why I was proud to help champion the Social Security Fairness Act in January 2025, which repealed WEP and the Government Pension Offset. As a result, this change restored Social Security benefits for millions of public servants, including teachers, and brought peace of mind to MA residents. 

On World Teachers’ Day, I’m proud to stand with our teachers. Thank you all for everything you do, not just today but every day.
